name: Gungnir
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level bloodrager 4, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 120-ft. line
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a fiery and glowing energy resembling that of the spear of Odinn, thrusting it forward in a straight line at your enemies. This deals 2d6 points of piercing damage per caster level (maximum of 20d6) to each creature within its area who fails their Reflex saving throw. This spear bypasses all DR except for DR/- and DR/Epic.
